description: This file defines a Perl class for a ResultSet related to 'Tag' in the Coocook schema, including methods for joining, filtering by names, and ungrouped tags.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Tag
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling collections of Tag objects within the Coocook schema, providing methods for joining tag names, filtering by tag names, and retrieving ungrouped tags.

methods.name: joined
methods.description: Concatenates all 'name' column values in the result set into a single space-separated string.

methods.name: from_names
methods.description: Filters the result set to include only tags whose 'name' is in the provided space-separated string.

methods.name: ungrouped
methods.description: Retrieves tags that are not associated with any group (i.e., 'tag_group' is undefined).
